about: The Council's reading of chapter 96 continues: the ram sent down in place of Isaac (Genesis 22) is Christ's flesh given for his divinity, and from it the argument turns to Adam and Eve and Mary the new Eve, who bore the Lord without corruption. Ezekiel's shut eastern gate (Ezekiel 44:1-2) and Moses' bush that burned without being consumed (Exodus 3:2) are read as figures of her.

sentences.l: Again when he-brought-him-up Abraham Isaac his-son onto mountain-of Qarmelewos(?), he-brought-down from-heavens ransom-of Isaac a-ram; and-Isaac-indeed not-was-slaughtered but was-slaughtered a-ram which-came-down from-heavens;
sentences.i: Again, when Abraham brought Isaac his son up onto Mount Qarmelewos (?), God brought down from heaven a ram as Isaac's ransom. Isaac himself was not slaughtered; the ram that came down from heaven was slaughtered instead;
sentences.n: The story of Genesis 22 (the binding of Isaac), read as a figure of Christ. ዓዲ 'again, moreover'. ሶበ 'when'. አዕረጎ is the 3ms perfect of አዕረገ 'bring up' (causative of ዐርገ 'go up') + -ኦ 'him' (so 'brought him up'); the object is then named by ለይስሐቅ (ለ- marking the object). ወልዲ 'his son' (-ዲ is Bezold's spelling of the 3ms suffix). ደብረ ቀርሜሌዎስ is a construct chain, 'mount of Qarmelewos'; CRUX: the name (ቀርሜሌዎስ, read qärmelewos) looks like Carmel, where Genesis 22:2 has Moriah, and I give it as written (?). አውረደ 'he brought down' (causative of ወረደ); the subject, God, is understood. ቤዛ ይስሐቅ 'ransom of Isaac' (construct); በግዐ is the accusative 'a ram'. ወይስሐቅሰ is ወ- + ይስሐቅ + -ሰ 'as for, indeed'. ኢተጠብሐ 'was not slaughtered': ኢ- 'not' + ተጠብሐ, a tä-stem (passive) perfect of ጠብሐ 'slaughter'. አላ 'but'. ዘወረደ is ዘ- 'which' + ወረደ 'came down'.

sentences.i: For Abraham is interpreted as God the Father, and Isaac, too, is interpreted as the likeness of Christ the Son;
sentences.n: The typology stated. እስመ 'for, because'. ይተረጐም is the 3ms imperfect of the four-letter verb ተርጐመ 'interpret, translate', here passive 'be interpreted, be explained'; በእግዚኣብሔር አብ is በ- 'by, in terms of' + God + አብ 'Father', so 'is read as God the Father' (the sense of በ- here is my reading). ወይስሐቅኒ is ወ- + ይስሐቅ + -ኒ 'also'. አምሳሊሁ is አምሳል 'likeness' (suffix-stem አምሳሊ-) + -ሁ 'his'; ለክርስቶስ ወልድ names the owner after the anticipating suffix, a pattern that recurs, so 'the likeness of Christ the Son'.

sentences.n: ወአመ 'and when, at the time that'; ይወርድ is a 3ms imperfect of ወረደ 'come down', here with past sense after አመ. ለመድኀኒተ is ለ- 'for' + መድኀኒት 'salvation, saving' (construct form -ተ before አዳም), 'for the salvation of Adam and his children' (ወደቂቁ 'and his children', ደቂቅ + -ሁ). ኢተጠብሐ 'was not slaughtered' (tä-stem passive, as in the last unit), with መለኮት 'divinity' as subject; ዘወረደ 'which came down'. ተጠብሐት is the 3fs form ('she was slaughtered'), agreeing with feminine ሥጋ 'flesh' + -ሁ 'his'. እንተ is the feminine relative 'which'; ለብሰ 'he put on' (3ms perfect of ለብሰ 'wear, clothe oneself'). በእንቲአነ 'for our sake' (በእንተ + -ነ 'us'). ይእቲ 'she, that (f.)' sentences.i: Do you grasp and examine this pattern and likeness of the earthly Isaac, the son of Abraham, who became an offering for his father's will?
sentences.n: ትሌብዉኑ is the 2mp imperfect of ለበወ 'understand, perceive' (from ልብ 'heart, mind') + the question enclitic -ኑ; the verb is a guess at the root, so 'grasp' is approximate (?). ወትጤይቁ 'and you examine' (2mp imperfect of ጠየቀ 'inquire, examine'). ዘንተ 'this' (accusative); አርአያ 'example, form' and አምሳለ 'likeness' are accusative nouns. ለምድራዊ ይስሐቅ: ለ- here shows the owner, 'of the earthly Isaac'. ወልደ አብርሃም is a construct chain 'son of Abraham'. ዘኮነ 'who became'; መሥዋዕተ 'an offering, sacrifice' (accusative predicate). ለፈቃደ አቡሁ is ለ- 'for' + ፈቃደ (construct of ፈቃድ 'will') + አቡሁ 'his father' (አብ + -ሁ, with the vowel -u- of the linking form).

sentences.i: A heavenly ram became his ransom, and the son of Abraham was ransomed. But for the one who came down, the Son of God, it was his earthly flesh that became the ransom for the divinity. He died in his flesh while his divinity did not suffer, and an exchange (?) came about;
sentences.n: ኮነ ሎቱ ቤዛሁ በግዕ 'there was for him his ransom, a ram'; ሎቱ is 'to him'. ተቤዘወ 'was ransomed' (tä-stem passive of ቤዘወ 'ransom'). ወለዘሰ is ወ- + ለ- + ዘ- 'he who' + -ሰ 'as for'; ወረደ 'came down'; ወልደ እግዚኣብሔር 'Son of God' (construct). ኮነ ቤዛሁ ለመለኮት ሥጋሁ ለምድራዊ: 'his flesh, the earthly, was ransom for the divinity', the owners named by ለ- after the anticipating suffixes. ሞተ 'he died'; እንዘ 'while' + the 3ms imperfect ኢየሐምም 'does not suffer' (ሐመመ 'suffer'); መለኮቱ 'his divinity'. sentences.n: ፈድፋደ 'especially, above all'. ናክብራ is 1cp imperfect/jussive of አክበረ 'honour, glorify' (causative) + -ኣ 'her'; whether it is 'we glorify' or 'let us glorify' the form cannot say, and I read it as a jussive. በምድርኒ and ወበሰማይኒ are በ- 'in' + noun + -ኒ 'also', 'on earth and in heaven both'. ለዛቲ እግዝእትነ names the object after -ኣ: ለዛቲ 'this (f.)', እግዝእት 'lady' + -ነ 'our'. ወላዲተ አምላክ is a construct chain, 'bearer of God' (ወላዲት, feminine participle: the Theotokos title). ወስምዑ 'and hear!' (2mp imperative). ዘኒ I take as an adverb 'also, likewise' (?). ፍካሬ ቀዳማዊ ብእሲ 'interpretation of the first man'; ዘውእቱ 'who is'. sentences.n: Genesis 3, the fall. ወሰሚዓ is the converb (gerund, 3fs) 'having heard' of ሰምዐ 'hear'. CRUX: ቃለ ሕብል is a construct chain 'word of ሕብል'; ሕብል means 'cord, rope', so I take it as a 'snare-word', a deceiving word, which the serpent spoke (?). CRUX: እምዕድዉ ለአዳም 'from the enemy of Adam': I read ዕድዉ as 'enemy, adversary', as in ch. 92-93 (ዕድዉ ለሰብእ, said of Satan), where it was also a guess from context (?); the serpent is meant, and ለ- is the genitive link after the noun (compare ዕበይነ ለሰብእ in an earlier unit). The other reading, ዕድው 'man' (ch. 35, 'from the man'), fits neither ለአዳም nor the sense. ኮነቶ is the 3fs perfect ኮነት + -ኦ 'to him' (to Adam): 'she became to him a killer'; ቀታሊተ is the feminine of ቀታሊ 'killer', accusative as predicate. በአዕልዎ is በ- 'by' + አዕልዎ, taken as the infinitive of a causative verb አዕለወ from the root of ዕልወት 'transgression' (used a few units on), 'by transgressing' (?); ትእዛዝ 'commandment' is its object.

sentences.i: She bore a heavenly king in the flesh, and he was born from her. He renewed life by the purity of his flesh, and killed death by his pure flesh; he rose without corruption and raised us with him to the deathless (?) throne of divinity, and brought us up to himself. We were changed into life (?) in our mortal flesh, and we found a life that does not die;
sentences.n: ወለደት 'she bore' (3fs perfect); ሰማያዊ ንጉሠ 'a heavenly king' (accusative). ወውእቱ ተወልደ 'and he was born' (tä-stem passive); እምኔሃ 'from her'. ወሐደሳ is the 3ms perfect of ሐደሰ 'renew' + -ኣ 'it', with ለሕይወት 'life' naming the object; በንጽሐ ሥጋሁ 'by the purity (construct) of his flesh'. ወቀተሎ is ቀተለ 'kill' + -ኦ 'him', with ለሞት 'death' as object. ተንሥአ 'he rose' (tä-stem); ዘእንበለ ሙስና 'without corruption'. ወአንሥአነ 'and he raised us' (causative አንሥአ + -ነ). ኀበ 'to, toward'; ኢመዋቲት is the negated feminine 'deathless', which agrees badly with masculine መንበር 'throne' (መንበረ መለኮት 'throne of divinity', construct), so I take them in apposition, 'to the deathless one, the throne...' (?). ወአዕረገነ 'and he brought us up' (causative of ዐርገ). ወተወለጥነ is the 1cp tä-stem passive of ወለጠ 'change, exchange', 'we were changed'; ሕይወተ 'life' (accusative) I take as what we were changed into (?), as the mortal 'became life' in unit 5; 'exchanged for life' is the alternative; በሥጋነ መዋቲት 'in our mortal flesh'. ወረከብነ 'and we found'. እንተ ኢትመውት is the feminine relative + the 3fs imperfect negated, 'which does not die' (ሕይወት is feminine).

sentences.i: Through Adam's errors we were afflicted (?), and through Christ's patience we were healed; through Eve's transgression we died and were buried, and through Mary's purity we were honoured and lifted up to the heights. Ezekiel prophesied again about Mary, and said: 'I saw a gate in the east, sealed with a great and wondrous seal, and no one entered it except the Lord of the mighty; he entered it and went out';
sentences.n: The Adam/Christ and Eve/Mary contrasts, then Ezekiel 44:1-2 (the shut gate of the sanctuary). በስሕታተ 'by the errors (of)' (በ- + ስሕተት plural in construct). CRUX: ተመንደብነ is a tä-stem 1cp perfect of the four-letter verb መንደበ 'afflict' (?), like ተመንደብኪ in ch. 91 (part 1 has the Aʾ form አመንደብዎሙ). ተፈወስነ 'we were healed' (passive of ፈወሰ). በትዕግሥተ is በ- + ትዕግሥት 'patience' (construct). በዕልወተ ሔዋን 'by the transgression of Eve'. ሞትነ 'we died' (1cp perfect), ተቀበርነ 'we were buried' (passive). በንጽሓ ለማርያም is 'by her purity, that of Mary' (ንጽሕ + -ኣ, with ለ- naming the owner). ከበርነ 'we were honoured' (ከበረ 'be honoured, glorious'), ተላዐልነ 'we were exalted' (tä-stem of ላዐለ, from ላዕል 'high'; compare ch. 90); እስከ አርያም 'up to the height, heaven'. ተነበየ ካዕበ 'prophesied again'; ሕዝቅኤል Ezekiel. ርኢኩ 'I saw'; ኆኅተ 'a gate' (accusative); ኅቱም 'sealed' (a passive participle of ኀተመ 'seal', as ተኀትመት in unit 20; 'shut' is ዕጹት in unit 19); ማኅተም 'seal'; በዐቢይ መንክር 'by a great wondrous (one)'. ወአልቦ ዘቦአ 'and there is none who entered'. The text prints ዘእንበ ለ as two words, to be read ዘእንበለ 'except' (the last syllable cut off by the printed word-space). እግዚአ ኀያላን 'lord of the mighty' (construct; ኀያላን plural of ኀያል 'strong'). ቦአ ውስቴታ ወወፅአ 'he entered into it (ውስቴታ, 'in her') and went out'.

sentences.i: And what he said further, 'No one entered it except the Lord of the mighty; he entered and went out': that is he who created heaven and earth, creator of angels and men and lords. He is the Lord of the mighty, the fruit of the divinity, Christ, who put on our flesh from her. He entered and went out, by what was hers (?), without corruption.
sentences.n: ወዘይቤሂ 'and what he said too' (ዘ- + ይቤ + -ሂ 'too, also'). The quoted words repeat Ezekiel's words from the earlier unit. ውእቱኬ is ውእቱ 'he' + -ኬ 'indeed, then'. ፈጣሬ is the construct of ፈጣሪ 'creator': ፈጣሬ ሰማያት ወምድር 'creator of heavens and earth', ፈጣሬ መላእክት ወሰብእ ወአጋእዝት 'creator of angels and men and lords' (አጋእዝት is the plural of እግዚእ 'lord'). ፍሬ መለኮት 'fruit (construct) of divinity'. ዘለብሰ ሥጋነ እምኔሃ 'who put on our flesh from her'; ክርስቶስ in apposition. CRUX: እንተ ኀቤሃ is the feminine relative 'which' + ኀቤሃ 'with her, at her'; the antecedent is unstated, and I read 'by what was hers' (?), the gate being in effect her virginal body. ዘእንበለ ሙስና 'without corruption'.

glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እግዚአ: እግዚእ — lord (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · construct 'lord of' (እግዚአ ኵሉ 'Lord of all')
glossary.ከርሡ: ከርሥ — his belly, his body (noun + -ሁ '3ms his') · his womb (ከርሥ 'belly, womb' + -ሁ; በውስተ ከርሡ ለአዳም 'within the womb of Adam', the house reading as in ch. 68)
glossary.ከበርነ: ከብረ — we are honoured, glorious (1cp perfect, G, k-b-r)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)'
glossary.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ) · 'if it is' after እመ, the subject the unborn child (ወእመሂ ኮነት ወለተ 'and if it is a daughter') · 'was' of place (ማኅደሩ ለእግዚኣብሔር ኮነት ህየ 'God's dwelling was there', ch. 95)
glossary.ኮነቶ: ኮነ — she became to him (3fs perfect ኮነት + -ኦ '3ms him', dative; ኮነቶ ቢጾ 'she became his companion', ኮነቶ ቀታሊተ 'she became his killer')
glossary.ወለዘሰ: ዘ — and as for him who (ወ- + ለ- + relative ዘ + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወለደት: ወለደ — she bore, gave birth (3fs perfect)
glossary.ወላዲተ: ወላዲት — bearer of, mother of (noun, fem., construct; active participle of ወለደ; ወላዲተ አምላክ 'Mother of God')
glossary.ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
glossary.ወሐደሳ: ሐደሰ — and he renewed her/it (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኣ '3fs her'; ለሕይወት 'life' stands as the doubled object)
glossary.ወሞተ: ሞተ — and he died (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-w-t)
glossary.ወሥጋሃ: ሥጋ — and her body, flesh (ወ- + noun + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወረከብነ: ረከበ — and we found (ወ- + 1cp perfect, G, r-k-b)
glossary.ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
glossary.ወሰሚዓ: ሰምዐ — and having heard (ወ- + gerund 3fs, G, s-m-ʿ; subject Eve)
glossary.ወስምዑ: ሰምዐ — hear, listen (2mp imperative, G stem; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወቀተሎ: ቀተለ — and he killed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወቀዱሶ: ቀደሰ — and having sanctified (ወ- + gerund 3ms, G, ḳ-d-s; written ቀዱሶ for ቀዲሶ)
glossary.ወቈጽላ: ቈጽል — and her/its leaf, foliage (ወ- + noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወበሐሤት: ሐሤት — and in gladness (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበምሕረቱ: ምሕረት — and by his mercy (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', written -ቱ)
glossary.ወበምሥራቅ: ምሥራቅ — and in the east (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበሰማይኒ: ሰማይ — and in heaven also (ወ- + በ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወበትዕግሥተ: ትዕግሥት — and by the patience of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወበንጽሓ: ንጽሕ — and by her purity (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ኣ '3fs her', written -ሓ)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወተላዐልነ: ተላዐለ — and we were exalted, lifted up (ወ- + 1cp perfect, tä-stem of ላዐለ 'be high')
glossary.ወተቀበርነ: ተቀብረ — and we were buried (ወ- + 1cp perfect, tä-stem passive of ቀበረ 'bury')
glossary.ወተቤዘወ: ቤዘወ — and he was ransomed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ቤዘወ 'ransom, redeem')
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተወለጥነ: ወለጠ — and we were changed (ወ- + 1cp perfect, tä-stem passive of ወለጠ 'change, exchange'; ሕይወተ 'into life' (?), 'exchanged for life' being the alternative)
glossary.ወተውላጠ: ተውላጥ — and a change, exchange (?) (ወ- + noun, accusative as predicate of ኮነ; noun from ወለጠ 'change'; cf. ተውላጥ 'change, alteration', ch. 9-12; the sense here is a guess) (?)
glossary.ወትጤይቁ: ጠየቀ — and you examine, investigate (?) (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, G, ṭ-y-q)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአመ: አመ — and when, on the day that (ወ- + conjunction/preposition)
glossary.ወአምሳለ: አምሳል — and likeness of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአንሥአነ: አንሥአ — and he raised us (ወ- + 3ms perfect, a-stem causative of ንሥአ, n-s-ʾ 'rise' (cf. ተንሥአ) + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወአዕረገነ: ዐርገ — and he made us ascend, raised us (3ms perfect, a-stem causative አዕረገ of ዐርገ 'ascend' + -ነ '1cp us'; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወአዳም: አዳም — and pleasantness (?) (ወ- + noun or adjective, perhaps from አደመ 'please'; sense uncertain) · ወአዳም ምሕረትከ 'and pleasing (?) your mercy': read as an adjective matching መንክር (?) · and pleasing (?) (ወ- + adjective, as in ch. 25-26 and 35), in ወአዳም ሥና 'and pleasing (?) beauty (?)'
glossary.ወአጋእዝት: እግዚእ — and lords (ወ- + plural አጋእዝት of እግዚእ)
glossary.ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወዕጹታ: ዕጹት — and her being shut (ወ- + ዕጹት 'shut', fem., participle of ዐጸወ 'shut', used as noun + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወዕፀ: ዕፅ — and wood, tree (ወ- + noun: accusative in ወዕፀ ዘኢይነቅዝ ጸሊመ 'and wood that does not rot, black', construct 'wood of' in ወዕፀ ቄድሮስኒ 'and cedar wood')
glossary.ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')
glossary.ወዘይቤሂ: ብህለ — and what he said also (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect ይቤ + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወይስሐቅሰ: ይስሐቅ — and Isaac indeed, as for Isaac (ወ- + proper name + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወይስሐቅኒ: ይስሐቅ — and Isaac also (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወይብልዋ: ብህለ — and they will say to her, call her (ወ- + 3mp imperfect + -ዋ '3fs her', b-h-l)
glossary.ወደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — and his children, sons (ወ- + noun + -u 'his')
glossary.ወገሃደ: ገሃድ — and openly, plainly (ወ- + adjective as adverbial accusative)
glossary.ወፍካሬሁ: ፍካሬ — and its interpretation (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms its')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ውእቱኬ: ውእቱ — that indeed (3ms pronoun + emphatic enclitic -ኬ)
glossary.ዘለብሰ: ለብሰ — who put on (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘቤዘወነ: ቤዘወ — who ransomed us (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ዘቦአ: ቦአ — that (it) entered (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ዘትነድድ: ነደደ — which burns (ዘ- relative + 3fs imperfect, G, n-d-d; subject ጳጦስ)
glossary.ዘኒ: ዘ — moreover, also (?) (ዘ + enclitic -ኒ; ስምዑ ዘኒ ፍካሬ 'hear, moreover, the interpretation'; ዘኒ ፍካሬሁ ስምዑ 'also its interpretation, hear'; precise force uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘእንበ: ዘእንበለ — except, without (preposition; split in the source as ዘእንበ ፡ ለ, the ለ standing apart)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ዘወረደ: ወረደ — which came down (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
glossary.ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ዘይኔጽርዎ: ነጸረ — which they look toward (ዘ- relative + 3mp imperfect, G + -ዎ '3ms it')
glossary.ያርኢ: አርአየ — he shows (3ms imperfect, a-stem causative of ርእየ 'see')
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይብልዋ: ብህለ — they call her (3mp imperfect, defective verb b-h-l, + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ይተረጐም: ተርጐመ — it is interpreted (3ms imperfect ይተረጐም, passive/reflexive ተ-stem)
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይወርድ: ወረደ — it will descend (3ms imperfect, G, w-r-d)
glossary.ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
glossary.ገብራ: ገብር — her servant (noun + -ኣ 'her') · they (f.) made, did (3fp perfect, G; here a verb, not 'her servant') · he made her (3ms perfect ገብረ + -ኣ 'her'; ገብራ ለንጽሕት 'he made her pure')
glossary.ጳጦስ: ጳጦስ — bush, bramble (noun; Greek loanword, cf. βάτος)
glossary.ፈደየት: ፈደየ — she paid, repaid (3fs perfect, G, f-d-y)
glossary.ፈጠራ: ፈጠረ — he created her (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r; + -ኣ 'her')
